sentences.text: On 1.27, the documentation recommends using KMS v2 for clusters running Kubernetes v1.27 or newer because it offers significantly better performance characteristics than v1.

citations.quote: New integrations that only need to support Kubernetes v1.27+ should use KMS v2 as it offers significantly better performance characteristics than v1

sentences.text: On 1.31, the documentation states that KMS v1 is deprecated (since Kubernetes v1.28) and disabled by default (since Kubernetes v1.29), and recommends using KMS v2 if feasible.

citations.quote: KMS v1 is deprecated (since Kubernetes v1.28) and disabled by default (since Kubernetes v1.29). You should use KMS v2 if feasible
